findings.message: Initial hidden state for "#p-question, #p-future, #p-free" is set via tl.set(...) at position 0 inside the paused timeline. A zero-duration set at 0 does not render while the playhead sits exactly at 0, so frame 0 shows the un-hidden state.
findings.fixHint: Use gsap.set(...) (immediate, outside the timeline) for initial states, or author the hidden state directly in CSS/attributes.
